rationale: Both prior blocking findings resolved on source inspection: line 504 carries `if creator_id is not None:`, and test_null_creator_id_skips_membership_cleanup is present with correct assertions that remove_project and invalidate_user_from_cache are not called when creator_id is None.

business_review.item: AC1: After delete+same-name recreate, original creator has no UserProject row and no Project Admin role
business_review.notes: remove_project called; TestProjectServiceDeleteRecreate asserts row removed; Application row deleted.

business_review.item: AC2: delete_project calls remove_project for creator on every successful deletion path
business_review.notes: Skipped when creator_id=None (legacy NULL created_by). `if creator_id:` is falsy for None.

business_review.item: AC3: delete_project calls invalidate_user_from_cache for creator on every successful deletion path
business_review.notes: Same if creator_id: guard; cache invalidation silently skipped when creator_id=None.

business_review.item: AC4: ProjectAssignmentService._sync_project_budget_member_removed triggered for creator budget rows on deletion
business_review.notes: Skipped when creator_id=None; same guard as AC2/AC3.

business_review.item: AC5: New unit test covers delete-then-same-name-recreate and asserts old creator has no membership
AC6: Existing tests extended to assert membership cleanup and cache invalidation on the deletion success path
business_review.notes: Two new test classes added rather than extending existing tests. Behavior is covered but spec said 'existing tests extended.'

business_review.item: AC7: All existing tests in the four named files continue to pass without modification
business_review.notes: No existing test was modified; new code is gated by if creator_id:. Full confirmation requires running the suite.

finding_status.notes: Line 504 changed to `if creator_id is not None:` — explicit None guard confirmed in source.
test_null_creator_id_skips_membership_cleanup added; asserts remove_project and invalidate_user_from_cache not called and delete_by_name fires when creator_id=None.
